title: Show "Question" heading for questions without explicit titles
summary: When someone plays a playlist and reaches a question step that has no title of its own, the page now shows the heading **Question** instead of no heading. Questions that do have a title still show that title, and notes without a title still show no heading. These tests build a small playlist with titled and untitled questions and notes, then play it on a computer-sized window and a phone-sized one.

setup.title: Open the preview build
setup.body: Use the **Open the preview build** button above, on a computer. If the page shows an error or doesn't load, the build may still be deploying: wait a few minutes and reload. If it looks like the old version, do a hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R on Windows, Cmd+Shift+R on Mac).

setup.title: Sign in
setup.body: Sign in with your email. You'll need to check your inbox for the sign-in code. Signing in lets you save the playlist the tests use. A private/incognito window gives you a clean start.

setup.title: Start a new playlist
setup.body: Open **Your content** (or the Discover panel), choose **+ Create**, then **Playlist**, and give it the title `Question heading test`. Then add the four steps below, in order, using **Add a step** each time.

setup.title: Step 1: a question with no title
setup.body: Choose the option described as **Ask readers to reflect** (a question). Leave **Title** empty. In the **Question** box type `What does light reveal in your life this week?`

setup.title: Step 2: a question with a title
setup.body: Add another question. In **Title** type `Light in the dark`. In the **Question** box type `Where have you seen light this week?`

setup.title: Step 3: a note with no title
setup.body: Choose the option described as **Your own words between steps** (a note). Leave its title empty and type `Welcome to this playlist.`

setup.title: Step 4: a note with a title
setup.body: Add another note. Give it the title `Closing thoughts` and type `Thanks for reading.`

setup.title: Save and start playing
setup.body: Save the playlist (**Save & Publish** or **Save Draft**), close the editor, open the playlist's own page from **Your content**, and choose **Start Reading**.

sections.title: Question headings on a computer-sized window
sections.intro: Keep the browser window wide (full screen on a laptop or desktop). The step's heading appears in the reader's header bar at the top.

tests.title: A question without a title is headed "Question"
tests.why: This is the main change. Before, this step's header was blank.
steps: While playing `Question heading test`, go to step 1 (the untitled question). Use the playlist's step list or its next/previous controls to move between steps.
Look at the heading in the reader's header at the top.
expected: Below it, the question text `What does light reveal in your life this week?` is shown as before.

tests.title: A question with a title is headed by that title
steps: Go to step 2 (the `Light in the dark` question).
Look at the heading at the top.
expected: The heading reads **Light in the dark**, not "Question".

tests.title: A question whose title is only spaces is headed "Question"
tests.why: A title made of blank spaces counts as no title, so it should get the default heading rather than a blank one.
steps: Edit the playlist and open step 2. Clear the **Title** field and type three spaces instead.
Save the playlist, start reading it again, and go to step 2.
Look at the heading at the top.
Afterwards, edit step 2 again, set its **Title** back to `Light in the dark`, and save.
expected: The heading reads **Question**, not a blank header.

sections.title: Question headings on a phone-sized screen
sections.intro: On narrow screens the heading appears at the top of the step's page rather than in a header bar.

setup.title: Use a phone-sized screen
setup.body: Either open the preview link on a phone and sign in with the same email, or make your computer's browser window as narrow as it will go (about the width of a phone). Then open the `Question heading test` playlist and choose **Start Reading**.

tests.title: On a phone, a question without a title is headed "Question"
steps: Look at the top of the step's page.
expected: A heading reading **Question** appears above the question text `What does light reveal in your life this week?`.

tests.title: On a phone, a question with a title is headed by that title
steps: Look at the top of the step's page.
expected: The heading reads **Light in the dark**, not "Question".

sections.title: Things that should not have changed

tests.title: A note without a title still shows no heading
tests.why: Only question steps get the default heading. Notes without a title should look the same as before.
steps: Go to step 3 (the untitled note), first on the wide window, then on the phone-sized screen.
Look at the top of the step.
expected: No heading is shown (in particular, not "Question"). The text `Welcome to this playlist.` appears as before.

tests.title: A note with a title still shows its title
steps: Look at the heading at the top.

tests.title: The question's hint and answer still work
steps: Edit the playlist and open step 1. In **Hint for readers** type `Think about a moment this week`, and in **Answer** type `In the way He provides`. Save.
Play the playlist again and go to step 1.
expected: The hint and the answer appear when you choose those buttons, and **Hide hint** / **Hide answer** hide them again.

notCovered: Other languages: the word "Question" hasn't been translated yet, so in other languages the heading shows in English until translators add it. That's expected for now.
The new automated tests in the PR, which run on their own.
